card.name: Inside polysorbate and glyco- words
card.fires_on: Responds to the middle piece of long chemical or medical words, mainly 'cos' in glycosylated or glycosaminoglycans and 'polys' or 'ys' in polysorbate or lipopolysaccharide.

modes.label: Glyco- words
modes.description: The 'cos' piece inside glycosylated hemoglobin or glycosaminoglycans.

modes.label: Poly- sugar and polysorbate words
modes.description: The 'polys' or 'ys' piece in polysorbate or lipopolysaccharide.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the word with the expected next piece, such as 'sorbate' or 'accharide'.
card.plain: It fires partway through long words like polysorbate and glycosylated, when the word is not yet finished.
